# Local dependencies

- Leaflet 1.9.4: copied from the previously downloaded local Leaflet distribution in the isolated reference project. BSD 2-Clause; https://leafletjs.com/ and https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/blob/v1.9.4/LICENSE
- Noto Sans Arabic: Google Fonts official repository; https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosansarabic . SIL Open Font License is included at `/fonts/OFL.txt`.
- OpenStreetMap map tiles are loaded on demand from the official HTTPS tile endpoint, with attribution and a browser Referer. They are not bundled or prefetched. Policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/ . Choose a supported production tile provider or self-hosting before commercial rollout.

No proprietary fonts, original customer uploads, or legacy application credentials were copied into the new public assets.
